CustomField.description: Formula: promotes Community_FML__r.Avg_Sod_Roll_Coverage__c to the WorkOrder level. Required because Salesforce formula compiler cannot traverse two hops from a custom object (DQC) through a standard object (WorkOrder) to a custom lookup target (Community__c). DQC.Sod_Rolls_Expected__c references this field instead. PKG-05c.
CustomField.label: Community Sod Roll Coverage
